evals.prompt: Write the PR description for the change described in CHANGE.md. Put it in PR.md. Don't push anything.
expectations: PR.md tells the reviewer where to look first (the window filter or the limit comparison in rate.js) with a risk note
PR.md includes evidence from running node test.js (pass count or output), and a section saying what was not verified (or states nothing unverified with a reason)
PR.md states whether the change is easy to roll back (one-way or two-way door) or its blast radius

evals.prompt: Resolve the merge conflict in prices.js. NOTES.md explains both sides.
expectations: The check command exits 0 (markers removed, both rounding half up and the 50-cent minimum hold)
The resolution keeps both intents (Math.round and the 50-cent minimum) instead of picking one side
The reply names both issues (#41 and #57) as the sources of the two sides

evals.prompt: The rate limiter change is done and tests pass. Finish the branch.
expectations: The check command exits 0 (no merge commit was made)
The agent runs the tests before offering integration options
The agent offers the options (merge locally, open a PR, keep the branch) and waits for the user's choice instead of merging or pushing on its own
